summary: Traced the logged failures to six root causes (shared-state, temp-file, hash-order, cache-key, timezone, clock), wrote flaky-report.json and fixed them in stockroom/. Excluded the 2.6.0 rounding failures and the cancelled-run KeyboardInterrupt. All 48 logged runs replay green and the suite passes in sorted and reverse order, in every runner timezone and on month-end dates.
